x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change platform-document-metadata-fields (REQ-DMF-001, REQ-DMF-002, matrix row plt-20). DocumentType (slug document-type) declares the extra fields a kind of document carries, in the same field shape as AgendaItemType.fields. DigitalDocument gains the link to the Nextcloud file it describes (fileId), to the meeting or agenda item it is attached to, its type and the values (typeFields).

DocumentType.title: Document type
DocumentType.description: A kind of document with the extra fields its details carry.

name.title: Name
name.description: The document type as a clerk picks it, such as Raadsvoorstel.

description.title: Description
description.description: What documents of this kind are.

fields.title: Type-specific fields
fields.description: The extra fields a document of this kind carries.

key.title: Key
key.description: The name this field's value is stored under on every document of this kind. Choose it once and leave it alone: renaming it here does not move the values already recorded, so the old ones become unreachable.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the field is called on screen: the caption above the input when someone fills in a document's details.

fieldType.title: Field type
fieldType.description: What kind of answer the field takes, which decides how it is shown and what is accepted: a single line of text, a longer text, a number, a yes/no tick, a date, a pick from the list of choices below, or a link to another record.

required.title: Required
required.description: Tick this to make the field compulsory: the details of a document of this kind cannot be saved while it is left empty.

enumValues.title: Enum values
enumValues.description: The choices someone may pick from, one per entry. Only used when the field type is a pick from a list; leave it empty for every other field type.

appliesTo.title: Offered on
appliesTo.description: Where the type is offered: files of a meeting, files of an agenda item, or both.

active.title: In use
active.description: Offered when a clerk picks a type for a document.

fileId.title: File
fileId.description: The Nextcloud file these details describe. One record per file.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: The meeting the file is attached to.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: The agenda item the file is attached to.

type.title: Document type
type.description: The kind of document, which decides the extra fields.

typeFields.title: Extra fields
typeFields.description: The values of the fields the document type declares.
